name: Caramel Appletini
desc: The Caramel Appletini is a wickedly smooth cocktail that blends flavors of tart green apple with rich, velvety caramel for a spellbinding sip.

name: Witch's Heart
desc: The perfect Halloween cocktail, Witch's Heart is a blend of berry and green apple flavors to help you get in the spirit of the season.

name: Sour Spell
desc: Sour Spell is a sweet vodka cocktail with a mischievous glow and a burst of sour rainbow candy flavor.

name: Vampire's Kiss
desc: Vampire's Kiss is a deep crimson vodka cocktail built around the unmistakable sweetness of red licorice flavor, layered with juicy strawberry and fruit punch flavor.

name: Golden Ace
desc: This grand slam of a vodka cocktail refreshingly blends the flavors of tart lemonade, fruity raspberry liqueur, and sweet honeydew melon.

name: Rum Swizzle
desc: Known as Bermuda’s national drink, the Rum Swizzle is a fresh and fruity cocktail enjoyed around the world.

name: Mango Habanero Margarita
desc: Tropical and fiery, this vibrant margarita pairs ripe mango and lime juices with a kick of habanero flavor. Each sip unfolds with the perfect harmony of sweet and heat.

name: Watermelon Margarita
desc: Like summertime in a glass, the Watermelon Margarita is a refreshing sweet and salty tequila cocktail blending watermelon, citrus, and triple sec flavors.

name: Calamansi Daiquiri
desc: Calamansi - bright, exotic, and irresistibly tart - transforms the classic daiquiri into something unforgettable.

name: Blackberry Mango Refresher
desc: Some days call for a little extra lift - and this lightly caffeinated Refresher delivers.

name: Peach Lychee Refresher
desc: With juicy peach and delicate lychee flavors, this lightly caffeinated Refresher is a gentle nudge in the right direction.

name: Strawberry Acai Refresher
desc: When you need refreshment, look no further. Flavors of lush strawberry and tangy acai blend in a perfect balance of sweet and tart.

name: Classic Collection Favorites Variety Pack
desc: All of our classics are together in one collection.

name: Strawberry Coconut Daiquiri
desc: The Strawberry Coconut Daiquiri is the perfect poolside rum cocktail with flavors of juicy strawberry, sweet coconut, and tart lime.

name: Lychee Martini
desc: Delicately fruity and lightly floral, the Lychee Martini is an elegant, slightly sweeter twist on a vodka martini.

name: Low-Cal Old Fashioned
desc: The Low-Cal Old Fashioned is a spirit-forward whiskey cocktail that perfectly balances bitter and sweet, with notes of oak and orange citrus.

name: Strawberry Guava Margarita
desc: Sweet and refreshing, the Strawberry Guava Margarita is a fruit-forward cocktail with tropical guava combined with flavors of strawberry, triple sec, and lime.

name: White Sangria
desc: Sangria is a lively, wine-based punch traditionally sweetened with fruit and fortified with additional liquor or liqueurs.

name: Tequila Sunrise
desc: This classic brunch tequila cocktail mixes orange juice with sweet grenadine cherry notes. Serve over ice in a lowball garnished with an orange wedge and maraschino cherry.

name: Painkiller
desc: Embrace the vacation mindset and put your troubles behind you.

name: Pomegranate Margarita
desc: A tart, refreshing addition to the collection of Bartesian Margaritas , the pomegranate margarita is a perfect pick for any tequila lover.

name: Espresso Martini
desc: A crowd-pleaser for even the most refined palates, the Espresso Martini is a smooth, sippable cocktail with notes of rich and creamy espresso and bold coffee liqueur.

name: Jungle Bird
desc: Take a tropical adventure to the jungle! The Jungle Bird is a unique tiki rum cocktail driven by pineapple juice balanced with refreshing lime and bitters.

name: Raspberry Ginger Gimlet
desc: The classic lime and gin cocktail gets a twist with flavors of sweet raspberry and a tangy ginger zing. Shake with ice and serve in a coupe glass.

name: Pineapple Margarita
desc: With summer on the horizon, there's no better cocktail than our new Pineapple Margarita, bursting with notes of juicy tart pineapple and sweet coconut, balanced with lime and notes of orange triple sec.

name: Sidecar
desc: The Sidecar is a cocktail that transports you straight to the roaring ’20s: smoky jazz clubs, glittering chandeliers, and effortless style.

name: Bee's Knees
desc: A sweet, citrus, and refreshing cocktail from the Prohibition Era, the Bee's Knees is a delicious pairing of lemon and honey, combined with floral notes of clover and alfalfa.

name: Hurricane
desc: Bring Mardi Gras home with the Hurricane. This sweet, fruity, and tropical rum cocktail derives tart and sour flavors from passion fruit and sweetness from orange juice.

name: Blackberry Margarita
desc: The Blackberry Margarita provides sweet and slightly tart berry notes with flavors of honeyed fig to create a juicy and jammy combination. Pairs perfectly with our Stemless Margarita glassware .

name: Apple Pie
desc: Your favorite dessert is now served as a whiskey and vodka cocktail.

name: Passion Fruit Margarita
desc: Embrace the aromatic flavors of Passion Fruit Margaritas at home whenever you please with the Bartesian cocktail maker and cocktail capsules.

name: Rum Runner
desc: Whether you’re embarking on a Caribbean getaway or mixing up the popular rum cocktail for guests in your home, the Rum Runner Cocktail is a popular choice for its smooth flavors and vivid aesthe

name: Mango Margarita
desc: This cocktail is a fruity, juicy, and refreshing margarita with a sweet blend of tequila, mango, and lime served over ice with a salted rim. Pairs perfectly with our Stemless Margarita glassware .

name: Low-Cal Margarita
desc: The low calorie Margarita is a classic, refreshing blend of tequila, lemon, and lime for a sweet and sour citrus experience. A salted rim perfectly complements the citrus of the fruits.

name: Amaretto Sour
desc: The Amaretto Sour pairs nutty almond and orange citrus notes to make for the perfect vodka dessert cocktail.

name: Whiskey Smash
desc: There are no sure things in life, but when you combine a Whiskey Sour and a Mint Julep the resulting delicious Whiskey Smash is about as close as you can get.

name: Low-Cal Whiskey Sour
desc: Ready for a guilt-free whiskey delight? Bartesian’s Low-Calorie Whiskey Sour capsules are here to shake up your cocktail game!

name: Aviation
desc: Bright, floral and slightly sweet, this gin favorite brings together flavors of Crème de Violette, Maraschino liqueur, and a squeeze of lemon for a drink that’s as refreshing as it is eye-catching.

name: Lemon Drop
desc: The Lemon Drop vodka martini is as tasty as its candy namesake but with the added bonus of vodka.

name: Jalapeno Lime Shrub
desc: Bartesian's Jalapeño Lime Shrub cocktail capsules create a cocktail that's like a lively dance of flavors on your tongue!

name: Northside
desc: With Moscow Mule-inspired flavors, this smooth, sweet and tart lime vodka libation, the Northside is like a cool breeze on a hot day.

name: Low-Cal Cosmopolitan
desc: Enjoy a guilt-free Cosmo with our low-calorie option! Tart cranberry is balanced out by the citrus of lime and the sweetness of orange to create this classic vodka cocktail.

name: Mai Tai
desc: A tropical classic with layers of bright lime, tart pineapple, and smooth almond flavor.

name: Ginger Peach Iced Tea
desc: Bartesian’s Ginger Peach Iced Tea capsules offer a delightful blend of flavors that creates the perfect cocktail for those warm, sunny days.

name: Spicy Margarita
desc: Ready to spice things up? This margarita is for you. Savor the classic combination of lemon and lime with a fiery twist of jalapeño and cayenne flavor.

name: Manhattan
desc: Named after New York City's Manhattan Club, this timeless cocktail stirred up its popularity with its mix of strong whiskey, sweet vermouth, and aromatic bitters. Garnish with a cherry.

name: Whiskey Sour
desc: The Whiskey Sour provides a smooth balance of sweet and sour. Notes of vanilla, lemon, and orange round out the flavor profile and make for a classic whiskey citrus cocktail.

name: Paper Plane
desc: The Paper Plane expertly blends bitter, herbal, and sour notes with elegant symmetry. The flavor profile of this whiskey cocktail is finished with a touch of lemon citrus and sweetness.

name: Old Fashioned
desc: The Old Fashioned is a spirit-forward whiskey cocktail that perfectly balances bitter and sweet, with notes of oak and orange citrus.

name: Cosmopolitan
desc: Tart cranberry is balanced out by the citrus of lime and sweetness of orange to create this classic vodka cocktail.

name: Sex on the Beach
desc: The most iconic beach cocktail of all time is undoubtedly the Sex on the Beach.

name: Rum Breeze
desc: The Rum Breeze features a sweet, tropical blend of pineapple, lime, and strawberry juices, light rum, and a hint of coconut. Fresh and flavorful, it’s a must-have addition to your at-home bar.

name: Uptown Rocks
desc: An elegant gin cocktail featuring peach and lemon with a graceful kick of cilantro flavor. Take gin drinks to the next level with an herbal gin for a smooth finish for this refreshing cocktail.

name: Margarita
desc: The Margarita is a classic, refreshing blend of tequila, lemon, and lime for a sweet and sour citrus experience. A salted rim perfectly complements the citrus of the fruits.
